amending_instruments.instrument: قرار مجلس هيئة السوق المالية رقم (2017-16-8)
amending_instruments.note_ar: الإصدار الأصلي؛ حلّ محل لائحة حوكمة الشركات السابقة الصادرة بقرار مجلس هيئة السوق المالية رقم 1-212-2006 وتاريخ 21/10/1427هـ (إحلال كامل بلائحة جديدة، لا مجرد تعديل).
amending_instruments.note_en: Original issuance; FULLY SUPERSEDED (not merely amended) the prior Corporate Governance Regulations issued under CMA Board Resolution 1-212-2006, dated 21/10/1427H.

amending_instruments.instrument: قرار مجلس هيئة السوق المالية رقم (2018-35-1)
amending_instruments.note_ar: عدّل درجة إلزام عدة أحكام (المادة 20(ب) الفقرة الفرعية، المادة 90 الإفصاح الإجمالي عن مكافآت كبار التنفيذيين، والملحق (1)).
amending_instruments.note_en: Changed the binding status of several provisions (Article 20(b) sub-paragraph, Article 90 aggregate senior-executive remuneration disclosure, and Annex 1).

amending_instruments.instrument: قرار مجلس هيئة السوق المالية رقم (2023-5-8)
amending_instruments.note_ar: أكبر تعديل مؤكَّد في هذا المسار: أعاد ترقيم اللائحة (على الأقل من المادة 24 فصاعداً، بإزاحة تراكمية تصل إلى -3) بما يتسق مع نظام الشركات الجديد (م/132 وتاريخ 1443/12/1هـ)، وعدّل نص عدة مواد (24، 37، 52، 54، 73، 74، 75، 87).
amending_instruments.note_en: The largest CONFIRMED amendment in this track's evidence: renumbered the regulation (at least from Article 24 onward, cumulative shift up to -3) to align with the new Companies Law (M/132, 1/12/1443H), and amended the text of Articles 24, 37, 52, 54, 73, 74, 75, and 87.

verification_methodology_note:
PRIMARY SOURCE: the official Corporate Governance Regulations PDF hosted on cma.gov.sa (CMA's own regulations-hosting domain; cma.org.sa 301-redirects to cma.gov.sa and is the same institution), fetched directly this pass at https://cma.gov.sa/RulesRegulations/Regulations/Documents/CorpGovReg.pdf (HTTP 200, 65-page born-digital PDF, 922KB). This IS the CURRENT, CMA-published, consolidated text -- its own cover page states it was issued under CMA Board Resolution No. (2017-16-8), dated 16/5/1438H (13/2/2017G), pursuant to the Companies Law then in force (Royal Decree M/3, 28/1/1437H), and has since been amended by Resolution No. (2023-5-8), dated 25/6/1444H (18/1/2023G), pursuant to the NEW Companies Law (Royal Decree M/132, 1/12/1443H). Cross-checked against CMA's own news/press pages (cma.gov.sa/MediaCenter/...) for the 2017 issuance, the 2019 (1440H) amendment episode, and the 2023 amendment episode.

CRITICAL CORRECTION OF THE COMMISSIONING BRIEF: the brief that commissioned this track described the instrument as 'CMA Board Decision 1-212-2006, dated 21/10/1427H ... amended 15/9/1440H (May 2019) alongside Companies Law changes'. Independent primary-source verification this pass found this premise is SUPERSEDED, not current: Resolution 1-212-2006 (21/10/1427H) WAS a real, earlier Corporate Governance Regulations, but it was FULLY REPLACED by an entirely NEW regulation under Resolution 2017-16-8 (16/5/1438H = 13/2/2017G), effective 22/4/2017G (most provisions) / 31/12/2017G (remainder) -- confirmed via CMA's own press release (cma.gov.sa/en/MediaCenter/PR/Pages/NewCGR.aspx). This is a full instrument REPLACEMENT, not an amendment of the 2006 text -- the 2006 instrument is superseded/repealed-in-substance and is NOT the current law. This track ingests the CURRENT (2017-issued, 2023-amended) regulation, which is 95 articles -- NOT ~19 articles as a prior light-pass claimed (that figure almost certainly describes the SUPERSEDED 2006 instrument, or an unrelated excerpt; it was independently found to be wrong for the current law by directly counting the primary PDF's own table of contents and body headers, which run an unbroken 'المادة الأولى' .. 'المادة الخامسة والتسعون', 1-95, plus a remuneration-table Annex (1)).

THE 15/9/1440H (20/5/2019G) AMENDMENT -- CONFIRMED REAL, BUT NOT LOCATABLE IN THE CURRENT TEXT'S OWN FOOTNOTE APPARATUS: a CMA press release (cma.gov.sa Arabic MediaCenter, matching Gregorian date ~27 May 2019 in one rendering and Hijri 15/9/1440H = 20 May 2019G in another) independently confirms the CMA Board approved an amendment to the Corporate Governance Regulation around this date, addressing board members' competing-business disclosure/authorization (implementing the Companies Law Article 72 amendment via Royal Decree M/79, 25/7/2018G). However: the CURRENT PDF's own amendment-footnote apparatus (28 numbered footnotes, individually enumerated and read this pass via font-size-based PDF layer extraction, each citing an explicit CMA Board Resolution number and date) contains NO footnote citing 15/9/1440H or a matching 2019 resolution number anywhere in the current 95-article text. The secondary source's described substance (board-member competing-business criteria delegated to the General Assembly, published on the company website, verified annually) matches, nearly word for word, the CURRENT Article 44, paragraph (3) -- and the current text is independently confirmed (via its own footnotes) to have undergone a renumbering by the 2023-5-8 resolution with a cumulative shift of -1 to -3 across different sections. The most likely explanation is that the provision amended in 1440H/2019 was numbered differently before 2023 (plausibly an 'Article 46' under the 2017-2023 numbering, consistent with the secondary source, corresponding to the current Article 44 after the shift) and that its amendment footnote was retired/removed once fully superseded by the 2023 re-consolidation. This mapping is PLAUSIBLE and CONSISTENT with all available evidence but is NOT independently confirmed from a primary source this pass -- see known_unresolved_discrepancies. Article 44 is NOT flagged معدلة in this track's own status_counts because no CURRENT-text footnote confirms it; only the 11 articles with an explicit, current, resolution-cited footnote are flagged معدلة.

ARTICLE COUNT AND STRUCTURE: 95 articles (المادة الأولى .. المادة الخامسة والتسعون), organized in 12 أبواب (Parts), 5 of which are further divided into فصول (Chapters) -- see chapter_structure. Independently counted three ways: (1) the PDF's own table-of-contents listing (95 'المادة' headers), (2) the PDF body's own 95 headers located by an ordinal-word matcher script covering 1-95, (3) a manual visual spot-check of the rendered page images at several points including the very end (Article 95: 'النشر والنفاذ'). One STRUCTURAL QUIRK independently confirmed by visual inspection of the rendered page image: Article 88's own heading in the PDF omits the word 'المادة' (reads simply 'الثامنة والثمانون: تقرير لجنة المراجعة'), unlike all other 94 articles -- this is a genuine typesetting quirk of the primary source itself, not a transcription artifact; number_label_ar for this article is still recorded with the normalized 'المادة' prefix for schema consistency, with the quirk flagged here.

TEXT EXTRACTION AND A CONFIRMED, PERVASIVE PDF FONT/CMAP DEFECT: this PDF's embedded font has a text-layer defect in which certain adjacent two-letter (and occasionally three-letter) Arabic sequences are encoded in REVERSED logical order relative to their correct spelling -- confirmed independently via (a) exact Unicode codepoint comparison of the 'buggy' vs. correct spelling for representative words, (b) OCR (tesseract, Arabic model) of the rendered page images, which reads the affected words in the CORRECT order (proving the defect is in the PDF's text/CMap layer, not a rendering artifact), and (c) direct visual inspection of rendered page images at 250-300 DPI for multiple spot-checks. This defect proved FAR more pervasive than a single letter-pair: an initial pass found and fixed teh+reh (تر) and lam+hamza-alef; a full-document word-frequency audit (repeated multiple times, working progressively down the frequency list) subsequently found this same reversal affecting at least 20 further distinct letter-pair/context combinations, several of them among the single most frequent substantive words in the entire document -- e.g. 'في' (in) extracted as 'يف' (336 of 343 raw occurrences), 'مجلس' (board/council) as 'جملس' (324 of 326), 'المادة' (article) as 'املادة' (229 of 229), 'التي' (which/that) as 'اليت' (100 of 100), 'إلى' (to) as 'إىل' (52 of 52), 'لجنة' (committee) as 'جلنة' (103 of 103), 'يجب'/'يجوز' (must/may) as 'جيب'/'جيوز', 'بما' as 'مبا', and roughly a dozen more (see the generator script's wordfix table for the complete, individually-annotated list, including the ~60 sound-plural/dual '-ين' endings extracted as '-ني', e.g. 'المساهمين' (shareholders) as 'المساهمني'). Each fix was individually verified -- never a blind positional or whole-class rule -- after a purely structural heuristic was tested early on and found to silently corrupt genuinely-correct words (e.g. 'المرتبطة', 'كامل', 'جميع'/'جيدة', 'حتى', 'مباشرة'/'مبالغ'/'مبادرات', 'اختصاصات'/'المختص') that happen to contain the same letter sequence in a different, unrelated grammatical role; every such collision candidate was checked in its actual document context before a fix was added or withheld, and several short/collision-prone tokens (e.g. 'يف'->'في', 'مبا'->'بما') were restricted to strict word-boundary matching rather than plain substring replacement after an unqualified substring attempt was shown to corrupt unrelated words (e.g. 'يفصح' 'discloses'). DISCLOSED RESIDUAL RISK: this was an iterative, frequency-ordered process -- each pass re-ran a full word-frequency count and inspected progressively lower-frequency bands (roughly down to words appearing 3-5+ times, covering the large majority of total word occurrences by volume across ~2,900 distinct word forms) until no further obviously-bugged high-frequency forms were found. It is NOT claimed to be exhaustive: the long tail of low-frequency vocabulary (a large number of distinct words appearing only 1-2 times each) was not individually re-verified word-by-word against the rendered page images, so an isolated, undetected instance of this same letter-transposition defect in rare vocabulary cannot be fully ruled out. This is disclosed as an honest residual-risk finding, not fabricated confidence, consistent with this corpus's 'could not confirm beats fabrication' standard -- a follow-up full manual proofread against the rendered PDF pages is recommended before this text is treated as a zero-risk verbatim source. Footnote paragraphs (28 in total, each either a resolution citation or a bare 'مادة/فقرة استرشادية' advisory-status tag) were stripped from article bodies via a stateful line-classifier (a footnote block starts with a bare 1-2 digit marker with NO following ')' -- this document's numbered list items instead use the ')N' convention -- and continues, excluded, until the next bare page-number line) and are NOT part of any article's 'text' field; their substantive content (resolution numbers/dates/targets) is instead captured in each amended article's 'history' entries and in this note. Arabic governs; no translation, paraphrase, or legal interpretation was performed on any Arabic wording. No pre-amendment wording was reconstructed or guessed for any of the 11 معدلة articles -- current text only, consistent with this corpus's zero-fabrication policy.

AMENDMENT HISTORY -- 5 distinct CMA Board Resolutions confirmed via the current PDF's own 28 footnotes (each self-declaring its resolution number, Hijri/Gregorian date, and target article/paragraph): 2017-16-8 (original issuance), 2018-35-1, 2018-52-4, 2022-94-1, and 2023-5-8 (by far the largest, renumbering the regulation and amending 8 articles' text). See amending_instruments and each معدلة article's own history entries. The 2023-5-8 resolution's renumbering was reconstructed from each affected footnote's own 'كانت المادة ... الصادرة بقرار المجلس 2017-16-8' cross-reference sentence (e.g. current Article 24's footnote states its provision 'كانت المادة الخامسة والعشرين' under the original 2017 numbering) -- this is a primary-source-grounded reconstruction, not an inference from secondary sources, though the FULL old-to-new mapping for every one of the 95 articles was not attempted (only the 8 articles whose own footnote discloses its prior number).

known_unresolved_discrepancies.description: The commissioning brief for this track described the current regulation as 'CMA Board Decision 1-212-2006 ... amended 15/9/1440H'. Independent verification found Resolution 1-212-2006 (21/10/1427H, 12/11/2006G) was a REAL, separate, earlier Corporate Governance Regulations, but it was FULLY SUPERSEDED (not amended) by an entirely new regulation issued under Resolution 2017-16-8 (16/5/1438H = 13/2/2017G), per CMA's own press release. This track ingests the CURRENT (2017-issued) regulation only; the superseded 2006 text is NOT part of this track and was not separately ingested. If the 2006 text is needed for historical research, it should be built as its own, clearly-flagged, separate historical track -- not merged into this one.

A prior light research pass reportedly cited ~19 core articles (citing uqu.edu.sa and argaam.com). Independent verification directly against the primary cma.gov.sa PDF's own table of contents and 95 body headers found this figure is WRONG for the current, in-force regulation -- the current text is 95 articles. The '~19' figure almost certainly describes either the superseded 2006 regulation (not independently verified this pass, since it is out of this track's scope) or a partial/summarized secondary treatment, not the current primary text. uqu.edu.sa and argaam.com were NOT relied upon as sources in this build; the primary cma.gov.sa PDF was used directly and its structure independently recounted rather than trusting the prior claim.

The 15/9/1440H (20/5/2019G) amendment is CONFIRMED REAL via a CMA Arabic press release (competing-business disclosure/authorization criteria delegated to the General Assembly, implementing Companies Law Article 72 as amended by Royal Decree M/79, 25/7/2018G), but no footnote in the CURRENT (2023-amended) PDF cites this specific 2019 resolution anywhere in the 95-article text. The secondary source's described substance closely matches current Article 44, paragraph (3), and the current text's OWN footnotes independently confirm the 2023-5-8 resolution renumbered the regulation (shift of -1 to -3 in different sections, e.g. current Art. 24 = old Art. 25; current Art. 37 = old Art. 39), making it plausible the 1440H-amended provision was 'Article 46' under the pre-2023 numbering and is now Article 44. This mapping is PLAUSIBLE but NOT independently confirmed from a primary source this pass. Article 44 is therefore recorded as اصلية (not معدلة) in this track, since only articles with an explicit CURRENT-text footnote citation are flagged معدلة -- an honest 'could not fully confirm' rather than a guessed معدلة flag or a fabricated footnote.

The primary PDF's embedded font has a pervasive text-layer defect that renders many specific two- and occasionally three-letter Arabic sequences in reversed logical order (confirmed via codepoint comparison and OCR cross-check against rendered page images -- see verification_methodology_note for the full account). This proved much broader than a single letter-pair: at least 20 distinct letter-pair/context combinations were found and fixed via repeated, frequency-ordered audits of the whole document's vocabulary, several affecting some of the single most common substantive words in the text (في, مجلس, المادة, التي, إلى, لجنة, يجب, يجوز, بما, and the sound-plural/dual '-ين' ending on ~15 further high-frequency words including المساهمين). Every fix was individually verified in its actual document context (never a blind positional or whole-class rule) after an early purely-structural heuristic was tested and found to silently corrupt several genuinely-correct words that happen to share the same letter sequence in a different role (المرتبطة، كامل، جميع/جيدة، حتى، مباشرة/مبالغ/مبادرات، اختصاصات/المختص) -- each such collision candidate was individually checked before a fix was added or withheld, and several short/collision-prone tokens were restricted to strict word-boundary matching after a bare-substring attempt was shown to corrupt unrelated words (e.g. 'يف'->'في' corrupting 'يفصح'). RESIDUAL RISK, DISCLOSED: this was an iterative process across ~2,900 distinct word forms, re-run repeatedly until no further obviously-bugged high-frequency forms were found (roughly down to words appearing 3-5+ times); it is NOT claimed exhaustive. The long tail of low-frequency vocabulary (words appearing only 1-2 times each) was not individually re-verified word-by-word against the rendered PDF pages in this pass, so an isolated, undetected instance of this same defect in rare vocabulary cannot be fully ruled out. A follow-up full manual proofread against the rendered PDF pages is recommended before treating this text as a zero-risk verbatim source; this is disclosed rather than silently assumed away.

Article 88's own heading in the primary PDF omits the word 'المادة' (reads simply 'الثامنة والثمانون: تقرير لجنة المراجعة'), unlike all other 94 articles in this instrument -- confirmed by direct visual inspection of the rendered page image (page 57 of the PDF), not a transcription artifact. number_label_ar is recorded with the normalized 'المادة' prefix for schema consistency with the other 94 articles; this quirk is flagged here rather than silently normalized away without disclosure.

The 2023-5-8 resolution's renumbering of the regulation was confirmed via each amended article's own footnote cross-reference to its prior (2017-numbering) article number, but this was only directly confirmed for the 8 articles that themselves carry a 2023-5-8 amendment footnote (24, 37, 52, 54, 73, 74, 75, 87). The complete old-number-to-new-number mapping for all 95 articles (needed to fully resolve, e.g., the 1440H amendment's current location with certainty) was NOT reconstructed in this pass and would require either a copy of the pre-2023 (2017-original) regulation text for direct comparison, or CMA's own gazette text of Resolution 2023-5-8 itself (neither was located/fetched this pass).

The regulation's Annex (1) (ملحق (1): جدول المكافآت, a remuneration-disclosure table referenced by Articles 90-91) is a tabular exhibit, not numbered articles, and was NOT transcribed into this track's articles set (consistent with this corpus's convention of tracking numbered المادة articles as the primary unit); its existence and the one confirmed amendment footnote touching it (Resolution 2018-35-1, making the table itself advisory while requiring detailed disclosure from FY2020 onward) are recorded here rather than silently omitted.

**تحفُّظ على سلامة النص**: يحمل 75 سجلاً من 95 في هذا المسار أثر انقلاب رابطة لام-ألف في النص العربي — «االطلاع» موضع «الاطلاع»، و«اإلدارية» موضع «الإدارية»، و«إعالن» موضع «إعلان»، و«الالزمة» موضع «اللازمة».

**وقد تُحقِّق من منشأ هذا الخلل، فهو في ملف المصدر الرسمي نفسه لا في قراءتنا له**: أُعيد جلب ملف الـPDF الذي يستشهد به هذا المسار (https://cma.gov.sa/RulesRegulations/Regulations/Documents/CorpGovReg.pdf)، واستُخرج نصّه بأداة مستقلة تماماً عن كل ما بُني به هذا المستودع (poppler/pdftotext) وبأنماط التخطيط الثلاثة جميعها، فظهرت فيه **1035** موضعاً من مواضع العطب نفسها. أي أن **الطبقة النصية للملف الرسمي مُرمَّزة هكذا**، ولا يستطيع أي مستخرِج أن يُخرج منها أفضل من ذلك، وأن **النص المخزَّن هنا قراءةٌ أمينة للملف الرسمي**. والصفحة المطبوعة تبدو سليمةً لعين القارئ؛ العطب في ما تقرؤه الآلة وحده. (التحقق: scripts/verify_pdf_source_encoding.py، وتفصيله في reports/corpus_text_integrity_audit/pdf_source_encoding_verification.json)

**وتصويبٌ لما قيل هنا سابقاً**: كان هذا التحفُّظ يقول إن «الجهة نشرت النص سليماً وإن الخلل في النقل». **وذلك خطأ**، قيل قبل إجراء هذا الاختبار، ويناقضه الاختبار.

**ولم يُصحَّح حرف واحد.** الانقلاب **يُحوِّل كلمات عربية صحيحة إلى كلمات عربية صحيحة أخرى**: «العالقة» (المُعلَّقة) قلبُ «العلاقة»، و«عالمة» (التي تعلم) قلبُ «علامة»، و«صالحية» قلبُ «صلاحية» — و«الشوائب **العالقة** ببدن السفينة» و«القضايا **العالقة** لدى المحامين» صوابٌ يقول ما يعنيه. فلا قاعدةَ آليةٌ تفصل العطب عن الصواب؛ الفصل يحتاج الجملة لا الرسم. وجُرِّب إصلاحٌ مشروطٌ بأن يكون الشكل المُصحَّح مشهوداً في نصوص المستودع السليمة فأخفق: الاستخراج يشطر الكلمة أيضاً («خ اال المدة» وأصلها «خلال المدة»)، وبعض «الشواهد» عطبٌ مماثل تسرَّب إلى مسارٍ آخر.

المُفصَح عنه أن **رسم بعض الكلمات في هذه السجلات لا يطابق الرسم الصحيح** وإن بقي المعنى مقروءاً، فلا يصح النسخ الحرفي منها قبل المقابلة بالصفحة المطبوعة. ورفعُ هذا التحفُّظ يكون بنسخٍ بشريٍّ من الصفحة المُصيَّرة، لا بقاعدة ولا بإعادة استخراج. (رصدَه scripts/audit_corpus_text_integrity.py)

**المستودع يحمل هذه الأداة مرتين**: يوجد مسارٌ آخر عنوانه يسمّي **الموضوع نفسه والنوع نفسه** — «لائحة حوكمة الشركات» (المسار `corporate_governance_regulation`، 95 سجلاً، تاريخه 2023-04-14) بينما تاريخ هذا المسار 16/5/1438، والنصّان يتقاطعان في 50% من مفرداتهما. **ولا يُقرَّر هنا أيّهما النافذ**: تأخُّرُ طبعةٍ ليس دليلاً على إلغاء ما قبلها — ففي هذا المستودع «نظام التأمينات الاجتماعية» مرتان لأن الطبعتين معاً ساريتان لفئتين مختلفتين. المُفصَح عنه أن **من يقرأ هذا المسار وحده يقرأ نصفَ الصورة**، وأن الحسم يكون بمراجعة المصدرين الرسميين. (رصدَه scripts/audit_corpus_text_integrity.py)
